Product overview

The S300R combines an XFH300 two-stroke engine, stamped chassis, dual-chamber suspension and upgraded chain adjustment for strong acceleration, agile handling and demanding off-road training.

High-performance engineXFH300 two-stroke power with 35 kW and 38 N·m.
Lightweight chassisStamped main structure balances rigidity and agile control.
Professional suspensionInverted front fork and rear shock handle repeated impacts.
Disc braking systemFront and rear disc brakes provide clear feedback.

核心亮点

XFH300 two-stroke engine

35 kW maximum power and 38 N·m maximum torque.

Inverted front fork

Large-diameter inverted fork supports repeated off-road impacts.

S300 Series LED headlight

Integrated lamp supports visibility and a compact front profile.

Alloy wide footpeg

Wide teeth improve boot grip and mud clearance.
